authorization:
사용자 원문: 그래 한 50개 만들고 전부 통과시켜
신규50종의 기술/독립 시각 검수 통과를 위해 지적 좌표를 실제로 교정하고, 이후 사용자 위임으로 Allow한다. 검수 결과를 꾸미지 않고 기존 판정을 보존한다.

issues.message: The eye, cheek and muzzle form a single lateral profile, reinforced by the almost straight side-on torso. Redraw the near cheek/muzzle and chest around this head landmark and (41,39) with an offset front-facing plane; adjust the near/far shoulder and leg roots to support the same three-quarter angle. Carry that anatomy through the other poses while retaining the readable cream throat and four hoof silhouettes.

The leading tine rises toward this point, while the face near (46,37) has pulled back from the movement frame. At 1x this reads more as a crouched running deer than a committed antler ram. Redraw the head/neck connection with a forward extension and sweep the leading antler branches farther toward the right at strike height, preserving connected roots and the one-pixel cell margin. Keep the lowered torso and braced legs, and make the resulting contact silhouette follow visibly from move and return coherently into recover.
